title: NFT Explorer
tagline: A beautiful NFT Explorer through which you can search for NFTs using a wallet / collection address on EVM chains!
description: This is a next.js project. It's an NFT explorer where people can search for NFTs held by a wallet address or by a collection address. Users can also search using ENS names like: "vitalik.eth". On top of this there is a feature called "Hide Spam" that hides the spam NFTs and only displays the legit ones. Its can be used on EVM chains!
how_its_made: This project uses Next.js for making the frontend, Alchemy SDK for making the API requests to get the NFT data on all the compatible EVM chains through wallet address or collection address. In addition to this users can also get held in their current wallet by connecting their wallet, so for wallet connection, Rainbowkit was used. The project was created by me using create web3 dapp! Using CW3D made it super simple to make!
